text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Tracen Academy is suuuper glamorous! There are lots of cool "Queens" around, but—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text: The most stylish, totally perfect queen of ours... is who!?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: Daring Heart, obviously♡

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I arrived at the cafeteria at lunchtime, as expected,
it was packed with students and academy staff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look over a racing paper while eating.
A quiet spot, away from the bustling center.
—That is my regular place.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Heart, over here, over here!
I saved the middle seat for you~♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Oh, thanks!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you a cheetah or something?
You're always so quick to act!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Standing right in the middle of a table in the center of the cafeteria
is my newly signed trainee—
Daring Heart.

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
"Heart, what're you eating today~?
High protein as usual? You're so super stoic!"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...
Let's see, today—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
It's a cheat meal! It's a celebration, so
I'm having cake and whatever else I want♪

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
And so... where is that genius who got the
best score on yesterday's pop quiz, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
...! Yes, yes, absolutely!
Aww, I'm so happy for the heart and celebratory lunch!
Thank you so muuuuch♡♡

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's Heart-san and the others.
That spot is always so dazzling.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Right? So dazzling~
Just what you'd expect from a "Queen" Heart!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
If you're aiming for Tracen Academy, it's the only choice! But it's that prestigious training club where just getting in is tough—
You're from "Jiluesta Academy," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
And she was supposed to be top elite among them...
Yet she's not stuck-up at all, cheerful with everyone, and super popular, always surrounded by friends...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Re~ally, it feels like they're living
in a whole different world from us..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: True, even in the crowded cafeteria, she stands out brilliantly... dazzlingly bright. I considered calling out to her as her Trainer, but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ――Oh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer!
Why are you doing a U-turn?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Couldn't you see
that your Umamusume was right here?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It's just that I saw you too clearly."
I almost let my true feelings slip,
and quickly held my tongue. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"‘I could just see you a little too clearly.’
I almost blurted out my true feelings,
only to quickly clamp my mouth shut. But—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Hmm?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Very well.
I can take my time talking with you after this anyway!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
See ya soon, Mr. Audience!
—Give it your all next time, okay?
choice_data_list: (She sees right through me... but still—)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
See ya soon, Ms. Audience!
—Give it your all next time, okay?
choice_data_list: (She sees right through me... but still—)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—I don't mind at all.
Because I already know what kind of Umamusume Daring Heart is.”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
My thighs are completely pumped full of acid!
All this strain from just one uphill run...!
choice_data_list: Shall we wrap it up here for today?
Should we call it a day here?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Are you kidding?
Of course... I'm keeping this going!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll catch my breath.
Grab some coffee and wait for me!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...Come on, Heart!
You can do it!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Behind Daring Heart's glamorous demeanor
lay a stoic hard worker that few would imagine. And—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—For training up until the debut, though, we'll do
squats, deadlifts,
bench presses... et cetera.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
There are a lot of muscle-building menus here.
I suppose in my case, reinforcing my physical foundation should come first?
choice_data_list: Yeah. You have a rather slender build compared to others in your generation.
Yeah. Your build is a bit slender compared to others your age.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
There may be limits to what training can achieve, but my body's peak is yet to come.
I will assess carefully and focus on building my physical strength.
choice_data_list: First, we'll build up your foundational muscle strength.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
First train the larger muscle groups to build a base,
then work on RFD—the rate of force development—
to improve explosive power.
choice_data_list: Let's increase your maximum strength and turn it into speed!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So if you were to write a thesis...
would it be something like "Correlation Between Maximum Muscle Strength and Explosive Top Speed"?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
You're that type, aren't you?
Earnest, level-headed... lacking humor, but on the other hand—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I can trust you.
—That's why I chose you.
choice_data_list: Do we need the humor part?
Do we need the humor part?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Oops, sorry!
……Fufu."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to this. Now, you'll be showing me your analytical prowess—the true depth of your intellect—to your heart's content, won't you?
choice_data_list: ...I'll do my best to live up to your expectations.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Yes! I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —Daring Heart is a glamorous, hard worker. And...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A slightly eccentric Umamusume who believed in
a plain person like me and signed a contract...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Just a light run, and we're done for the day.
Shall we get going?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hopped on my bicycle and chased after her.
"Running alongside" each other as a cooldown had become a complete regular routine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Huff... huff...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...You look pretty relaxed.
Getting used to running side by side?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
In that case,
that means we can pick up even more speed...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
――Nice work!
Great job today!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, don't look at me so begrudgingly.
I just wanted to wear myself out completely.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Because on my perch—by your side,
I wanted to rest with all my might.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...You'll let me do that, won't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, Trainer.
I will become... a true queen."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Win the Triple Tiara
and become the most radiant Queen. To that end—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I need your strength.
Will you promise me... that you'll give it your all?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For just a moment, I hesitated to take her outstretched hand. Was I truly worthy of being her Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I reach out a hand slowly.
With just a little more distance to go――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't be shy!
No need to be embarrassed, okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: âLook.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She firmly took my hand in a handshake.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ……Once again.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'll be in your care, okay?
—My trainer.
